The user wants to fill 30 gallons, but the tank can hold up to 50 gallons. We don\'t know current fuel level. The user says "so that I end with 40 gallons". That implies current fuel is 10 gallons? But we don\'t know. The user wants to fill 30 gallons. The function fillFuelTank expects fuelAmount: number, the amount to add. So we call fillFuelTank with 30. But we need to check if that would exceed capacity. We don\'t know current fuel. The function will return error if over capacity. But we don\'t know current fuel. We could call get_current_speed? No. There\'s no function to get current fuel level. There\'s displayCarStatus with option "fuel". We could call displayCarStatus with option "fuel" to see current fuel. Let\'s do that.')
